scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic and includes exact floor-boundary conventions; numerical finite tests are auxiliary. The original cycle-enumeration theorem is prior work. The published journal revision could not be read in full. Publication priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The formula applies to one-dimensional affine floor maps with 0<epsilon<=1/2 and offset uniform over a complete conjugacy period. No statement for other noise models, slope ranges, or arbitrary offset laws.
title: Exact two-cycle multiplicity distribution at the negative-flip boundary of quasi-affine maps
